_comment: The complete set of sling subcommands, captured from `sling --help` and each `sling <cmd> --help` on v0.1.124 (2026-10-27). The scope_flags rules were captured by running each command under `--agent`, not read from help text, which renders them abridged. This file exists so a test can prove SKILL.md never routes to a subcommand that does not exist, and never routes a GitHub state change to sling. Update it, and the changelog, when a sling release adds or removes a command; a new command must also be given a reviewed entry in `classification`.

local_only_user_runs._comment: Commands that change only the user's own machine (a credential, an installed binary) and that the USER runs, never the agent. None of them touches GitHub or CI state.

classification._comment: One reviewed class per captured command, so a new command fails the suite until someone classifies it on purpose. read_only: reads data or local state and changes nothing. local_only: changes only the user's own local sling state (the saved credential or the default org), never GitHub or CI. local_only_user_runs: changes only the user's machine and the USER runs it, never the agent. There is no class for a GitHub or CI state change: such a command would have to route to the user or to gh, and the contract would change with it.

doctor_checks._comment: The nine check keys `sling doctor --agent` emitted on v0.1.124, split by whether a failing row is something the agent acts on (actionable) or only reports (advisory: never makes doctor unhealthy, and its fix_command is never run by the agent).

scope_flags._comment: --org <slug> and --repo <owner/name> are per-command, not global. Every rejection below exits 2 with nothing on stdout. No command reads --repo from the git remote of the current directory; without --repo, runs list, usage and top cover the whole org, and jobs list exits 2 unless given --run, --repo or a window.

exit_codes.3: not found, or no stored logs
exit_codes.10: remote outcome failed (doctor unhealthy, or runs show --wait on a non-success run)

global_flags_note: `logs` rejects --org and --repo (strict parser, exit 2, `Unknown flag "--org"`). `time` rejects --org outright (exit 2) and needs --repo for its repo view, which it never reads from git. `runs list`, `jobs list`, `usage` and `top` reject --org together with --repo (exit 2, `Use --org or --repo, not both.`). Unknown flags are ignored everywhere except `logs` and `update`.
